commits_since_review.subject: Turning the 3D map is smooth again: a label repainted as its size crosses a sharpness step is sent to the graphics card alone, into its slot of the atlas page, where the whole 2048 by 2048 page was sent again each time, 16 MB a frame while the map turned, so frames came every sixth to eighth refresh (from 0019ec90, map-speed; traced 2026-10-17)

A repainted label is sent to the graphics card by WebGL itself with the rest of its slot cleared, and many repainted in one frame go with their page sent whole: three.js's copy asked the card for five settings per copy, 17 ms a frame while the map turned, and sent the label alone, leaving earlier pixels beside it that showed as slivers at its edge (independent check of 2d7ed336, 2026-10-17)

The roundtable forensics of 2026-10-16 with its raw data: the reconstruction, the runaway-and-load review, and what the 66 Start-all agents completed, with every session and ticket of the night (artifacts/ stays ignored; these files are added by name)

Agents are asked to link the files that are entry points of the functionality they work on, and no write is refused for want of a link: the write lock, with its Codex asking mode, command sandbox, confined terminal and read-only ignore list, is deleted, not switched off, after its drawbacks were weighed; a ticket worker's first prompt carries the work_link request once, so linked entry points still put the work on the map for later agents (CTX-060 amended, CTX-061, CTX-062 and CTX-064 withdrawn, 2026-10-18)
The fake agent loses what only the write lock's tests drove: codex-acp's asking mode and requests, the write gate and the permission request's path

decisions: The latest main checkout is authoritative. The reverted requirement that a file be linked before writing, asking mode, command sandbox, confined terminal and read-only ignore controls are not restored.
Existing work claim conflict checks, configured controls and dynamic blacklist remain operative.

The archive physically declares 16 native roles. The user's operative request adds GC-owned Role Creator; the implementation registers 17 including role_creator and retains functionality for independent FQC.
Existing prompt identity dispatch:system, the selected version's source/parent history, and user-authored register are preserved by targeted migration.
No live user prompt store or memory graph was inspected, reset or changed. Selected-version reconciliation and receipts are demonstrated in isolated actual prompt-store/MCP/ACP fixtures.
